messages:
maya: Quick heads up — saw a weird quality regression after HF->Redwood conversion for model slipstream-7b when rope_scaling != 1.0 and sliding_window=true. Repro attached below.

eli: Can you paste the conversion config + tokenizer diff? suspect special token remap or max_pos mismatch.

maya: HF config snippet:
```
"rope_scaling": 0.95,
"sliding_window": true,
"num_key_value_heads": 32,
"max_position_embeddings": 2048
```
Redwood-converted config (what ended up on infra):
```
"rope_scaling": 1.0,    # missing original scaling in converter
"sliding_window": false, # converter defaulted false
"num_key_value_heads": 16,
"max_position_embeddings": 1024
```
Weirdness: converter seems to drop rope_scaling and fall back to defaults which then mismatches kv head mapping and max pos.

josef: That combo will shift positional offsets during generation. sliding_window=false + lower max_pos will force truncation of cached KV and the shifted special tokens can cause context to align differently — explains hallucination drift. Also rope_scaling being changed breaks RoPE interpolation we rely on after quant.

quant-bot: :warning: eval-run: slipstream-7b-quant8 showed regression: Perplexity +12%, Rouge-L -3.4%, task-accuracy drop 6.8% vs fp16. See https://internal.eval/runs/8742

eli: Oof. Can you share a tiny repro command? I'll run a quick quant smoke locally.

maya: Minimal repro:
```
python tools/convert_hf_to_redwood.py \
  --model slipstream-7b \
  --out-dir /tmp/redwood_slip \
  --check-config --dump-token-diff
```
The token diff shows extra <|special_1|> inserted at prompt boundary when sliding_window is toggled.

josef: Short-term mitigation: force these in runtime mapping until converter is fixed:
- set rope_scaling: 0.95
- override max_position_embeddings: 4096
- map num_key_value_heads -> 32

maya: I'll open RN-3274 with the conversion team. Plan: add conversion sanity checks that fail fast if rope_scaling present in HF and not propagated; require explicit flag to change sliding_window. Adding unit test for kv head divisibility and a smoke eval that runs k=100 prompts after conversion.

eli: I'll run the quant smoke and ping infra for a hotfix flag to patch runtime configs.

maya: Will post PR link here once ready. For anyone triaging today: prefer pinning to slipstream-7b-no-rope variant or set runtime override `ROPE_SCALING_OVERRIDE=0.95` until fix. :eyes:

quant-bot: Noted — alert escalated to eng-ml + eng-runtime.

maya: Updating RN-3274 with logs, token diffs, and eval links. Will report back in ~45m after smoke.
